ctaHeading: Ready for a garden refresh in Montmorency?
aboutText: With years of hands-on experience in residential landscaping and an Associate Degree in Horticulture, I provide specialised gardening services across Montmorency and surrounding Banyule areas. From routine garden maintenance and irrigation systems to custom metalwork and outdoor lighting, I deliver personalised solutions that enhance your outdoor space. My commitment is to quality workmanship and understanding the unique needs of local gardens.
servicesText: We offer a full range of gardening services tailored to Montmorency's conditions, including maintenance, plant selection, and irrigation. Our expertise ensures your garden thrives with minimal fuss, whether it's a small touch-up or a complete renovation.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Mulching
services.desc: Regular upkeep such as mowing, weeding, and mulching to keep your Montmorency garden neat and healthy throughout the seasons.

services.title: Plant Selection & Advice
services.desc: Expert guidance on choosing plants suited to your soil and climate, ensuring beautiful and sustainable growth in your garden.

services.title: Irrigation Installation
services.desc: Custom-designed sprinkler and drip systems that conserve water while maintaining lush greenery in your outdoor areas.

services.title: Steel Edging & Trellising
services.desc: Bespoke metalwork for garden borders, paths, and plant supports, adding structure and visual appeal to your space.

services.title: Tree Work & Pruning
services.desc: Professional pruning and care to promote tree health, safety, and aesthetics in residential and commercial properties.

services.title: Garden Renovations & Lighting
services.desc: Complete transformations including redesigns and outdoor lighting to create functional and inviting evening gardens.
